title: Stenc Spec Component Catalog
description: Comprehensive schema-v2 fixture for every native spec field and supported rich block primitive.

page.humanSummary: One fixture exposes the complete spec vocabulary so maintainers can review renderer coverage on a single page.
page.agentSummary: Use this catalog to verify that every schema-v2 spec field and every current rich primitive remains validated and rendered.

body.goal: Lock the current schema-v2 spec component inventory with realistic, validator-approved content.
body.problem: Small examples exercise isolated fields but do not reveal when a renderer change omits or visually collapses a supported spec component.

in: Every current schema-v2 spec body field
Every current rich block and inline span type

architecture.summary: The catalog remains canonical JSON, passes through the shared validator, and renders through the fixed Stenc page generator.

requirements.title: Complete native field coverage
requirements.detail: The fixture must populate every current schema-v2 spec field with concrete content.
acceptanceCriteria: The validator accepts the catalog without compatibility fallbacks.
The generated page exposes all primary spec sections.

requirements.title: Complete rich primitive coverage
requirements.detail: The fixture must include every supported inline span, callout tone, and rich block type.
acceptanceCriteria: All seven inline span types appear in one paragraph block.
Neutral, info, success, warning, and danger callouts are present.
Quote, table, media, task list, and source diagram blocks are present.

approaches.name: Single comprehensive catalog
tradeoffs: Provides one stable renderer inventory surface
approaches.recommendation: Use one comprehensive fixture as the semantic coverage contract.

approaches.name: Many isolated fixtures
tradeoffs: Makes omissions across the full document harder to spot
approaches.recommendation: Retain focused behavior tests, but use this catalog for complete inventory coverage.

components.name: Structured source fixture
components.responsibility: Represent every current spec contract field without renderer-only meaning.

components.name: Fixed renderer
components.responsibility: Project the canonical fixture into consistent human-readable sections.

dataFlow: Validate native fields and bounded rich blocks

errorHandling.behavior: Validation fails with the exact unsupported path before rendering.
The renderer shows a fixed missing-media panel without changing the JSON source contract.

contracts.name: Canonical source contract
rules: JSON remains the only document source.
Renderer classes do not define document meaning.
Every extension uses a validator-known supporting primitive.

contracts.name: Diagram source contract
rules: The diagram block stores escaped source text.
No browser runtime executes the diagram source.

testingStrategy.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='renders comprehensive spec and plan component catalogs' skill/stenc/scripts/setup-project.test.js
testingStrategy.expected: The inventory test reports only renderer semantic classes that are not implemented yet.

validation.purpose: Confirm the examples-app and standalone spec fixtures are byte-identical.
Validate the complete fixture collection against the live schema.

agentInstructions: Keep this catalog aligned with the validator whenever a spec field or rich primitive changes.
Add new source primitives to the schema before expecting the catalog to use them.
Preserve byte parity with the standalone example fixture.
reviewChecklist: Every current native spec field contains concrete content.
Every inline span and callout tone is visible.
No renderer-only meaning or per-document styling is present.

selfReviewChecks.name: Schema completeness
selfReviewChecks.purpose: Compare the fixture against REQUIRED_BODY_FIELDS, BODY_FIELDS, and optional schema-v2 spec fields.

selfReviewChecks.name: Primitive completeness
selfReviewChecks.purpose: Compare blocks against RICH_BLOCK_TYPES, INLINE_SPAN_TYPES, and CALLOUT_TONES.

selfReviewChecks.name: Source integrity
selfReviewChecks.purpose: Confirm the fixture is structured JSON with no unsupported visual controls.

notes: Use the related plan for renderer implementation sequencing.
Do not introduce structured diagrams until the dedicated diagram slice.

supportingSections.heading: Rich Primitive Inventory
supportingSections.content: These bounded blocks exercise the current rich rendering contract while core behavior remains in native spec fields.
items: Inline semantics stay explicit in typed spans.
Callout tone is selected from a fixed validator-known set.
Media and diagram blocks remain local and non-executable.
